title: TBC Anniversary

order: 10-50: Cruelty, Unbridled Wrath, Commanding Presence, Enrage, Dual Wield Spec, Sweeping Strikes, Flurry, Bloodthirst (40), Precision, Blood Craze, Rampage (50)
51-57: 5 Deflection, then 2 Improved Charge
58-63: 3 Improved Thunder Clap, 2 Improved Overpower, 1 Anger Management

keyAbilities.name: Bloodthirst
keyAbilities.why: Main hitter from 40, use on cooldown

keyAbilities.name: Whirlwind
keyAbilities.why: Turns spare rage into damage, best on multiple mobs

keyAbilities.name: Sweeping Strikes
keyAbilities.why: Lets you handle two mobs at once; pool rage first

keyAbilities.name: Victory Rush
keyAbilities.why: Free hit after a kill, keeps chain-pulling going

keyAbilities.name: Rampage
keyAbilities.why: Stacking attack power buff once gear is decent

leveling.tip: Pull mobs a bit below your level, pool rage before double pulls, and keep food and bandages handy since warriors barely self-heal.

endgame.name: Protection (tank)
endgame.notes: One core build; flex points go to Improved Demoralizing Shout or Improved Defensive Stance. A threat variant takes Impale for crit-heavy gear.

endgame.name: Arms Slam (raid DPS)
endgame.notes: Two-hander build, slightly stronger than dual-wield but busier to play. A dual-wield Arms variant can pull ahead with the Warglaives of Azzinoth.

endgame.name: Fury (raid DPS)
endgame.notes: Dual-wield build that dips Arms for Impale and Death Wish and takes Rampage deep in Fury. Precision points can shift into Improved Execute as hit gear improves.

keyAbilities.name: Judgement

keyAbilities.name: Crusader Strike

keyAbilities.name: Repentance

endgame.name: Retribution (raid DPS, with Kings)
endgame.notes: Nearly every Ret talent is required; key ones are Sanctified Judgement, Vengeance, Crusader Strike and Sanctity Aura. Skip the Blessing of Kings point only if another paladin covers it.

endgame.name: Holy (raid healer)
endgame.notes: Essentially one build since most of the Holy tree is mandatory. Three flex points (e.g. Purifying Power, Blessed Life).

endgame.name: Protection (tank)
endgame.notes: Survival-leaning build with flex points in Spell Warding and Pursuit of Justice. A threat variant reaches Sanctity Aura in Ret, worth it only without a Ret paladin in the group.

keyAbilities.name: Frenzy

endgame.name: Survival (raid DPS)
endgame.notes: Taken for Expose Weakness; a raid wants exactly one because it doesn't stack. Also needs 20 Marksmanship points for Mortal Shots.

order: Before 22, take Improved Fireball, Elemental Precision and Ignite. At 22, respec into Frost AoE: Elemental Precision, Frost Warding, Permafrost, Improved Frost Nova, Improved Blizzard.
From 23 to 49, take Icy Veins, Piercing Ice, Arctic Reach, Frost Channeling, Cold Snap, Improved Cone of Cold, Shatter, Ice Barrier, Arctic Winds and Ice Shards.
Take Summon Water Elemental at 50 and finish Ice Shards, then go into Arcane: Arcane Subtlety, Arcane Focus, then Arcane Concentration (58-62).
From 63 to 70 add Arcane Fortitude, Magic Absorption (5) and Arcane Meditation (2), for a final 18/0/43.

keyAbilities.name: Blizzard
keyAbilities.why: Main AoE grinding spell; with Improved Blizzard it also slows the pack.

keyAbilities.name: Frost Nova
keyAbilities.why: Roots the pack so you can reposition and keep casting.

keyAbilities.name: Cone of Cold
keyAbilities.why: Burst AoE finisher, and it crits more on frozen targets thanks to Shatter.

keyAbilities.name: Summon Water Elemental
keyAbilities.why: Extra freeze and a pet that tanks or finishes single mobs.

keyAbilities.name: Ice Lance

leveling.tip: Set your hearth near your grind spot and mail loot to a bank alt; Icy Veins' guide mentions the Slave Pens AoE method for 60-70.

endgame.name: Arcane (raid DPS)

order: 10-29: Improved Corruption, 2-3 points in Suppression, Improved Life Tap, then Improved Drain Soul, Soul Siphon, Amplify Curse and Fel Concentration (5).
30-49: Improved Curse of Agony (2), Empowered Corruption, Nightfall, Destructive Reach, Siphon Life, then Shadow Mastery, Contagion and Dark Pact.

50-59: Unstable Affliction, 1 point in Shadow Embrace, Improved Howl of Terror (2) and Curse of Exhaustion if you're on a PvP server. Then move into Demonology: Demonic Embrace, Improved Healthstone, Fel Stamina, Fel Intellect, Demonic Aegis and Fel Domination.
Around 60, Icy Veins suggests respeccing into the Shadow Mastery/Demonic Sacrifice build for steadier damage. For dungeon cleaving from 60 to 70, a DS/Emberstorm build or a Felguard build both work.

keyAbilities.name: Unstable Affliction
keyAbilities.why: Biggest damage gain at 50. Cast it first, then refresh your other DoTs.

keyAbilities.name: Corruption
keyAbilities.why: Instant DoT that you spread across mobs, and it procs Nightfall.

keyAbilities.name: Life Tap
keyAbilities.why: Turns health into mana, so you rarely stop to drink.

keyAbilities.name: Drain Life
keyAbilities.why: Gets health back after Life Tap and keeps you going between pulls.

keyAbilities.name: Incinerate
keyAbilities.why: Learned at 64. Costs less mana and casts faster than Shadow Bolt.

leveling.tip: Pair with a healer or buffer (Paladin, Druid, Shaman) if you can, and let the Voidwalker or Felguard take hits while your DoTs tick.

endgame.name: Destruction (raid DPS)
endgame.notes: Main raid spec, built on Shadow Bolt or Incinerate with Improved Shadow Bolt, Bane, Shadow and Flame and Devastation. Nether Protection can replace some points on hard fights.

endgame.name: Affliction (raid DPS)
endgame.notes: Brought mostly for raid utility (Malediction curse, Shadow Embrace, Shadow Mastery debuff). Ruin can replace Unstable Affliction while you're undergeared.

endgame.name: Destro Nightfall
endgame.notes: Keeps a pet out and adds Shadowfury cleave. Does less damage than standard Destruction and is mostly used for heroics.

order: 10-29: Ferocity (5), Thick Hide (3), Brutal Impact (2), Feral Swiftness (2), Sharpened Claws (3), Predatory Strikes (3), Primal Fury (2).
30-49: Faerie Fire (Feral), Savage Fury (2), Nurturing Instinct (2), Heart of the Wild (5), Leader of the Pack, Improved Leader of the Pack (2), Survival of the Fittest (2), Predatory Instincts (5).
50-60: Mangle at 50, then go into Restoration for Furor (5) and Naturalist (5).

keyAbilities.name: Shred

keyAbilities.name: Faerie Fire (Feral)

keyAbilities.name: Dire Bear Form

endgame.name: Restoration (raid healer)

endgame.name: Feral Bear (tank)
endgame.notes: Wowhead's standard Feral build, which handles both bear tanking and cat DPS. Key talents are Mangle, Predatory Instincts, Survival of the Fittest and Leader of the Pack.

route: Start in Hellfire Peninsula at 58 and quest out of Thrallmar or Honor Hold until about 62, then move to Zangarmarsh (60-64) and pick up the Cenarion Expedition quests, which also start your heroic-key rep.
Head to Terokkar Forest around 62 (grab Shattrath City and pick Aldor or Scryer), then Nagrand from about 64. Nagrand's The Ultimate Bloodsport chain is a big weapon upgrade.

Finish 66-70 across Blade's Edge Mountains, Netherstorm and Shadowmoon Valley. In Shadowmoon your Aldor/Scryer choice decides which hub you use. Do the zone's dungeons as you reach them for gear, or chain-run dungeons if your gear is strong; Frost Mages can also AoE-grind instead of questing.
At 70 learn flying (it unlocks at max level). You need it for Skettis, Ogri'la, the Netherwing dailies and the Arcatraz part of the Karazhan key chain.

Heroic keys come from Revered rep: Honor Hold/Thrallmar (Flamewrought Key), Cenarion Expedition (Reservoir Key), Lower City (Auchenai Key), The Sha'tar (Warpforged Key), Keepers of Time (Key of Time). Run heroics for Badges of Justice to buy catch-up gear from G'eras.

Phase 3 raids still need attunement on Anniversary realms. Hyjal: The Vials of Eternity from Soridormi plus Keepers of Time rep (Wowhead says Honored seems to be enough on Anniversary). Black Temple: the Aldor/Scryer chain in Shadowmoon Valley that ends with the Medallion of Karabor. Wowhead says older-phase attunements such as Karazhan stop being required once Phase 3 opens, and attunements are account-wide.
notes: Raid talent builds come from the wowsims TBC simulator's presets. Gear lists are pre-raid and catch-up items from Icy Veins and Wowhead, and don't include Hyjal or Black Temple drops.
phase: TBC Anniversary Phase 3 (Mount Hyjal + Black Temple) went live August 27, 2026 per Warcraft Tavern news; level cap 70.
